summary: Two independent R3 reviews agree that v27 is self-contained and closes prior policy, projection, status, transaction, lease, replay-retry, cleanup, Gate-loader and CCC gaps, but still mixes cutoff-wide and per-T future-poison oracles, lacks nested-directory publication rules, has no crash-commit protocol for authority generations, does not durably resolve conditional retry events, conflicts M7 replacement retries with the remaining 16-fit budget, fails to bind exact 17+4 check identities to the official behavior schema, and omits nullable sort and clean launcher environment rules.

limitations: Both reviewers were read-only and did not edit design, product, test, gate or ledger files.
Neither reviewer invoked quality_ledger or ran replay, training, real data, PIT certification, budget consumption or final-OOS access.
